issues.description: Some procedural recommendations (micro‑workflow steps 1, 3, 4 and the final 'Poznámka pro praxi') are presented as factual or prescriptive but lack explicit grounding/citation. The section's first sentence is marked as 'General background knowledge', yet the workflow and practical note are not explicitly labeled, which violates the rule to mark unsupported statements as general background knowledge or back them by a source.
issues.required_fix: Either add supporting citations from the KB for these procedural recommendations or explicitly label the micro‑workflow and the 'Poznámka pro praxi' as 'General background knowledge' (and keep them concise).

issues.description: Inconsistent use of the 'General background knowledge' label: it appears at the start of the section but not for other advisory paragraphs (micro‑workflow, Poznámka). This may confuse readers and conflicts with the grounding rules.
issues.required_fix: Make labeling consistent: mark each paragraph that contains general, advisory, or non‑KB‑sourced guidance with '(General background knowledge)' or add KB citations where available.

issues.description: Footnotes are embedded inside itemize/enumerate items (which is allowed) but could produce layout issues if the document class/style treats footnotes differently. Also the explicit inline label '(General background knowledge)' appears as plain text; consider formatting consistently or using a LaTeX macro/comment to avoid layout surprises.
issues.required_fix: Optionally move footnote markers to the end of full sentences for clarity and ensure the '(General background knowledge)' label is typeset consistently (e.g., as a short italic note) or replaced with a macro used consistently across the manual.

issues.description: The section briefly recommends actions (e.g., 'uložte verzi pro revizi') that are sensible pedagogical practices but not referenced to KB evidence. Readers might expect a short rationale or link to best practices in evaluation/quality control.
issues.required_fix: Either add a one‑sentence rationale (as general background knowledge) explaining why saving versions and reviewing AI outputs is recommended, or cite an appropriate KB excerpt if available.
